decision: held: no open full text for any declared PMID (29037431 Clin Nutr 2018; 35331862 Complement Ther Med 2022; 23234816 Hepatogastroenterology 2012), so meta-analysis doses, dosage forms and included trials cannot be verified; record claim is Healthy Aging/Longevity, which none of the abstracts measures directly
summary: Abstracts only. The two meta-analyses report modest TC/LDL and SBP reductions (29037431: 19 RCTs, 797 subjects; 35331862: 10 RCTs, 539 adults, only 2 trials verified supplement content). The NAFLD trial (23234816) was open-label and confounded: the chlorella arm got 1200 mg/day extract with metformin 750 mg/day while controls got metformin 1250 mg/day. Without full text no complete context can be verified, so Dr. Pham's A056 source-content hold stays.
